CatOS: CatOS is a fictional operating system designed by Petro. It features custom desktop environments, playful GUIs, and unique ecosystem tools.
GuardianOS: GuardianOS simulates PETCON threat levels with a pygame GUI, filesystem, and scenario engine. It is inspired by Perimeter/Dead Hand systems.
Xenocode: Xenocode is an alien-themed programming language ecosystem with its own interpreter, IDE, documentation, and test suite.
ReactorOS: ReactorOS is a fictional nuclear reactor operating system built with C++ SDL2 and Winsock, featuring SCRAM logic and emergency countdowns.
BuddyTalk Messenger: BuddyTalk Messenger is a custom MFC/Win32 chat client using the BTMSG protocol, Winsock networking, and a playful GUI.
Msg++: Msg++ is a C++ messenger project with server, client, GUI, protocol, and encryption features.
FilmTrust: FilmTrust is a Python GUI + audio project that generates PNG rating cards, integrates emoji fonts, and plays WAV sound packs.
